$comment: Source-of-truth for the three Base44 entity schemas that must be registered via the Base44 dashboard (app.base44.com). Entity creation is dashboard-only — the Base44 SDK and REST API expose no entity-registration endpoint. After registering each entity, run: npm run schema:apply-rls

entities.name: CardState
entities.description: FSRS scheduling state for one card (or one cloze deletion). One record per (card, clozeIndex) pair.

cardClientId.description: clientId of the associated Flashcard. Indexed for lookup.

stability.description: FSRS stability parameter (S). Days until 90% retention.

nextReview.description: YYYY-MM-DD date of next scheduled review.

ratingHistory.description: Per-card rating event log (capped at 50 entries) for calibration scoring.

suspended.description: If true, card is excluded from all review queues.

buriedUntil.description: YYYY-MM-DD: exclude from queue until this date.

migrated.description: Set to true by the migration script to mark this record as migrated.

clozeIndex.description: For cloze cards: which deletion index this scheduling row represents. Null for basic cards.

sourceCardClientId.description: For generated cards (cloze, image occlusion): clientId of the parent note. Null for basic cards.

entities.name: CardHistory
entities.description: Immutable audit log entry created whenever AI modifies a card. Allows viewing and reverting to any prior version.

card_id.description: clientId of the Flashcard this history record belongs to.

version.description: Sequential version number starting at 1. Higher = more recent.

content_snapshot.description: Full card content at the time of the change: { front, back, elaboration, source, tags }.

modified_by.description: Who made the change. 'ai' means an LLM-assisted edit was applied.

ai_model_used.description: Model identifier used for AI edits. Null for user edits.

entities.name: UserSchedulerParams
entities.description: Single-record table (one row per user) storing fitted FSRS parameters.

params.description: Fitted FSRS parameter array (19 values). Defaults to ts-fsrs defaults if absent.

lastFitDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of last parameter fit.

reviewCountAtFit.description: Number of reviews available when parameters were last fitted.

fitVersion.description: Version of the fitting algorithm used.
